Moth Signal is an offline Morse-code listening game. Gameplay does not use accounts, ads, analytics or a remote server. Your current game is held in memory and resets when you reopen the app.

No microphone, camera, or location access is needed. Sound is generated on your device after you tap Play; you can switch it off and use the flashing lamp or written hint. Playback stops when you leave the app. Reference links open external websites only when selected.

This is a development test build, version 0.1.0. It has not been submitted to the App Store or Google Play. Fictional moths and radio-tower stories are used as a game setting.
